headline: Ark Invest Rotates $43.5M Into Coinbase and Circle as Bullish and Bitmine Exit
summary: In crypto news today (July 31), Bitcoin climbed -0.4% overnight and is sitting just below $64,000 following a turbulent week that saw the Fed freeze interest rates on Wednesday, although SEC Chair Paul Atkins hinted at hikes to come, which has caused a slight weakening of crypto assets and stocks ...
